_note: Onboarding content. Edit the words here. Flow: name and how often you play, pick your own level, then a checklist of the skills that are new at that level (earlier levels are collapsed and assumed done, but can be opened and changed). Skill names and level descriptions come from framework.json.

levelChoices.text: New to padel, learning the basic shots and where to stand.
I can rally slowly. Still learning to use the glass.
Steady rallies. Starting to come to the net and hit bandejas.
Comfortable at the net. I use the glass well and play with a plan.
Strong competitive player. I choose my shots on purpose under pressure.
Coming soon. For now I'll check you at A.

levelNote: Levels like A, B, C and D mean different things at different clubs and in different countries. Your level here comes from this app's skills checklist, so it may not match your club. That's fine.
disclaimer: This is a starting point, not an official rating. You can change it any time.

lines.welcome: Hi! I'm your Padel IQ coach. Three quick steps and I'll find your starting level. It takes about a minute.
lines.name: What should I call you? (optional)
lines.level: What level would you say you are?
lines.checks: Here's what a {level} player can do. How about you?
lines.resultMixed: You're {level}, with a few skills to work on.
lines.resultAllYes: You're a solid {level}. Want to check the level above?
lines.resultLower: {level} might be a stretch for now. {lower} looks closer.
lines.resultLowest: Great place to start. Everyone begins here.
lines.upFailed: {up} isn't there yet, so you stay at {level}. Good to know what's next.
lines.checksNote: Think about your normal games, not your best day. There are no wrong answers. Earlier levels are ticked for you. Open one to change anything.
lines.checksBeginner: Just starting out? Great. A few quick ones. There are no wrong answers.
lines.length: Quick check or the full one? Either is fine.
